dog.description_text:
This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Romulus was surrendered to the care center as a stray after spending three days with her finder, so we have only limited history on her behavior in a home environment. Her finder describes Romulus as an affectionate dog who can be a couch potato. During intake, Romulus showed highly fearful behavior, escalating to hard barking and growling at staff, and her finder also reported that she displayed this behavior towards unfamiliar people while in their care. Romulus has shown social and affiliative behavior with staff given a slow approach and time to warm up. We recommend placement with a New Hope partner who can allow for decompression, provide any necessary behavior modification (force-free, positive reinforcement-based) and re-evaluate behavior in a stable home environment before placement into a permanent home.
